marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 你的夢想可能有點風險 : YouTuber六指淵 帶你找到屬於自己的人生副本 | Ni de meng xiang ke neng you dian feng xian : YouTuber Liuzhiyuan dai ni zhao dao shu yu zi ji de ren sheng fu ben

Lu Ziyuan was once a child who was addicted to video games, performed poorly in school, had no special talents, and left parents and teachers shaking their heads in frustration. During middle school, in an attempt to get attention from his peers, he began showcasing himself—yet with limited resources in his environment, he was forced to embark on a path of self-directed learning. Without formal instruction, he mastered visual effects and eventually became a top-tier VFX artist. He attended a vocational high school specializing in printing, and by his second year, he had already founded SIXVFX, an online platform for VFX education. Skilled in photo editing, animation production, and 3D modeling, he began building an online presence in his third year of high school, sharing a large volume of video content. Determined to gain admission to a national university through recommendation, he found ways to produce a substantial portfolio of video projects, despite having no access to school equipment or resources. He successfully created a unique learning portfolio and was admitted to National Yunlin University of Science and Technology. There, he continued to self-learn and master advanced technical skills in 3D effects and programming. After graduating from university, he launched his own business—and by the age of 25, he had become an entrepreneur with annual revenues in the eight-figure range
